notes.title: Space Mechanic Simulator Developer Insights 85
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Space Mechanics![/b][/h1]

Welcome to the next [b]Space Mechanic Simulator[/b] Developer Insights. Today we will touch on the topic of blueprints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29653827/9b3fcc243c902635b2477ab8cda15451be6a3e77.png[/img]
[h3][b]Why do I need blueprints?[/b][/h3]
Diagrams are now essential - you may get a mission where they tell you a pump stopped working, and you will have to figure out why. Maybe it's the electric motor in the pump that failed. Maybe it's the PLC controller that has the wrong program or is damaged. Or maybe a battery has failed and nothing has power? This makes diagnostics an actual part of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29653827/ab191b6bc92c5ebdc66702f29bf027510c71543a.png[/img]
[h3][b]Palmtop is fun[/b][/h3]
Palm has received new features that allow you to check, for example, the installed program. In addition, you will be able to correct erroneous programs and install correct ones to PLCs. This is not the end of the changes. Visually, we've also made quite a few improvements and, of course, device animations. They no longer just stand in one fixed position, but gently wobble from side to side.


As always, we’d like to thank everyone once more for supporting us and sharing your feedback on our forums, social networks. Stay tuned for more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/429380/Space_Mechanic_Simulator/

[h2]Join our community on Discord! 🫵[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40530711/5f81653430f771754a9012f6d0d1d8ab9cc8f0f2.png[/img][/url]


That is it for today.
See you soon!

notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Space Mechanics![/b][/h1]

Welcome to the next [b]Space Mechanic Simulator[/b] Developer Insights. In today's entry, as always, we want to cover topics related to work on the full version and the 1.2.8 patch for Prologue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29653827/3d56f330a99493242894c88886e70c20784ce91d.png[/img]

[h2]Prologue Update 1.2.8[/h2]
The latest patch for the prologue will introduce a pretty big change – controller support and a changed look of key assignment setting options. The system is consistent and friendly. If by some miracle it does not suit you, of course, you will be able to make changes yourself. Each key can be assigned in different ways, you can double-click, use our drag and drop system. We point out at the start that not all devices are supported – there are so many on the market that we can't support them all. By the way, we also improved lighting and shading and some other small bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29653827/5329b222067adebf67b0a5d95b82802cb52f03df.png[/img]

[h2]Full Version[/h2]
The work on the final game is in full swing in recent weeks we have been working on locations.
The launch is approaching very soon. We are entering the final stages of production and polishing the game to the best possible state.

notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Space Mechanics![/b][/h1]

Welcome to the next [b]Space Mechanic Simulator[/b] Developer Insights. The last few days have been working on updates and controller support for the prologue.


[h2]Prologue Updates[/h2]
In between developer entries, there was one update with the number 1.2.7. It introduced quite a few improvements, including new rover physics and quite a few optimizations on Mars. The prologue's support does not end there. We are in the process of creating support for controllers. The goal is clear. We want to give you the opportunity to play SMS the way you want. So if you prefer a game pad, you will be able to play comfortably on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29653827/9db583dc5af234532e014ad315f1a0368c913526.png[/img]

[h2]More to come[/h2]
Thank you for the warm reception to our prologue, at the time of writing this text the average rating is 86%. We know that the game is not perfect, however, we are glad you liked it. After releasing and patching the most important problems. We returned to the preparation of the full version of the game - will appear sooner than you expect.  With the experience of the prologue in our minds, we are confident that you will also like it even more.

notes.title: Space Mechanic Simulator: Prologue Patch 1.2.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40530711/e9ccb665aa382a0b1d60c723ed21aece73054db3.png[/img]
[h1]Hello Space Mechanics! [/h1]

Patch 1.2.7 is up. We've fixed the problems you reported. We've improved optimization, and we have made a lot of needed bug fixes.

[b]Full patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved performance on Mars surface mission
[*] Updated Rover physics
[*] Added auto reset when Rover is stuck on objects
[*] Fixed bug with parts not being highlighted properly, even blocking part, then needed to be accessed to finalize mission
[*] Added "Skip" button, allowing player to ignore message that mission cannot be finalized and proceed to next mission regardless
[*] Fixed bug causing crushes on older AMD CPU
[*] Fixed bug causing player dialog to loop endlessly
[*] General stability fixes
[*] Fixed a rare bug, causing game to freeze while changing the keybindings
[*] Small UI improvements
[*] Flipped two loading screen screenshots to look better
[/list]

As a remainder, we are still working on the full game. If you got any ideas, we invite to talk about them on our Discord or post them in the comments below.

[b]Join our community on Discord![/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/xhQmGdqBu4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40530711/5f81653430f771754a9012f6d0d1d8ab9cc8f0f2.png[/img][/url]

Have fun,
Atomic Jelly

notes.title: Space Mechanic Simulator: Prologue Patch 1.2.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40530711/4b08ac37f10561ad654c4b17f233988a965ffc0b.png[/img]
[h1]Hello Space Mechanics! [/h1]

Update 1.2.6 is here. We have added some Quality of Life improvements, and needed fixes.

Full patch notes:
- adjustments to planet texturing
- HUB and service station markers now merge into single shuttle marker when further away
- mission objects now also have markers, except for station in last mission which did not need it
- Labels displayed on HUB are now more compact
- main crosshair only shows on HUB while in fly mode. It is also removed for Mars rover
- fly away button in corner of HUD no longer lets mouse clicks through
- adjusted astronaut inertia and mouse sensitivity during repairs. Also made mouse sensitivity during repairs scale with field of view
- mouse cursor does not move when looking around - it stays where it was left by player
- mouse cursor is confined to game window only in full screen window and exclusive full screen modes
- removed unused UI control bindings
- controls binding panel now warns about existing bindings when rebinding, allowing to abort button overwrite
- Quick load button can now be used from main menu, with the exception of exit screen and graphics options confirmation screen
- fixed bug when binding new keys could also trigger those keys - like quick load or escape (close of UI panel)
- while connecting cables, game will automatically switch to screwdriver if player wants to tighten or loose a screw that locks cable port
- all objects that can be moved by hand no longer require to put away current tool
- fixed bug that caused fusion cell in first mission to be highlighted too soon
- notification now shows on screen after quick save
- fixed bug causing Palmtop not to use buttons actually assigned in controls menu, but default bindings only
- fixed bug causing HUD popup labels show after loosing connection to rover
- fixed bug that made scrolling conversation list in repair mode change camera FOV at the same time
- added name of person talking to narrative panel
- new icon for drone on narrative panel
- additional popup confirmation when aborting mission
- new loading screens

[b]Join our community on Discord![/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/xhQmGdqBu4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40530711/5f81653430f771754a9012f6d0d1d8ab9cc8f0f2.png[/img][/url]

Have fun,
Atomic Jelly

notes.title: Space Mechanic Simulator - Prologue PLAYTESTS Patch 1.1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40530711/4e80d05c6e76bc4334d92fe076fd80d5b22cdbd4.png[/img]
[h1]Hello Space Mechanics!🧑‍🚀[/h1]

Today we have another one, including some needed fixes based on your feedback - mainly focusing on the IR camera and tutorial messages. Thank you once again for your reports.

[b]Change log: 📋[/b]
- additional tutorial messages in some places that could be confusing to player
- fixed IR camera measurement mode
- fixed minor bugs related to IR Camera
- fixed issue with tutorial panel obstructing some mouse clicks near it
- added more dynamism to heat sources in E01M01 (pumps and fusion cell)
- added dynamism to electric devices heat production
- increased text area size on exit screen to contain all the text
- when trying to plug cable to port that is locked, port screw will be highlighted in flashing red and cable insertion attempt animation will be visible
- when trying to unplug cable from port that is locked, port screw will be highlighted in flashing red
- translation improvements
- updated tutorial texts with proper PLC port names
- added missing object designations in back panel of Solar 1 satellite (E01M00), which cased them to use the same generic names, such as "Medium pipe" etc.
- added missing floor to cargo container in E01M02

This is the last patch that will appear for our playtests. Which doesn't mean we're done collecting your opinions and feedback. We will continue to do so, please share them with us using our survey. We need some time to assemble the Prologue in its entirety and polish the various gameplay elements.

[h2]After playing, we encourage you to fill out our survey, which will allow us to understand your expectations about our game even better: [/h2] ✍️ https://forms.gle/bbBNe4LXiHpqUzwC9

[h2]Need Help?🔧[/h2]
If you experience any technical issues accessing or playing Space Mechanic Simulator - Prologue Playtests, please visit our Discord/Steam where our team is ready to help troubleshoot any issues you encounter.

[h2]Join the community on our Discord! 🫵[/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/xhQmGdqBu4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40530711/5f81653430f771754a9012f6d0d1d8ab9cc8f0f2.png[/img][/url]

Have a good one!
Atomic Jelly Team

notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Space Mechanics![/b][/h1]


Welcome to the next [b]Space Mechanic Simulator[/b] Developer Insights from the last weeks are here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29653827/b2924232de943edb96ff3fa8223d7a5c67d611bc.png[/img]

Change is the key word of recent weeks. Quite a few have appeared, We have improved the rover, improved map stations graphically, improved and updated the game with more mini-games making the game more interesting.
